title: The Big Bang's afterglow was found as antenna noise
body: Penzias and Wilson in 1965 could not scrub a stubborn hiss from their Bell Labs antenna; they cleaned out pigeon droppings, the noise stayed. It was the cosmic microwave background at about 2.7 kelvin, the cooled remnant of the hot early universe, predicted years earlier. They received a Nobel Prize for refusing to ignore static.
